Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
j-train1 wrote:
> I am sure this has been asked in the past ,but i can't find it looking
> up keywords
>
> Ok, when zombie/crows/wolfs kick in during strike resolution. Do you
> need more then one Fort card to prevent damage from hand strike and
> enviromental damage or can one fort card prevent all damage from all
> sources?

The latter.

The damage is all piled together. If your one prevention effect can prevent
enough points of damage, it doesn't care that the various points of damage came
from different sources.

Unless card text indicates that it does care, of course. Skin of Steel can only
prevent damage from a strike, for example.

> Also are the wolf and zombie the same type of applied damage for
> zombie says "takes1 additional damage during strike resolution" but
> wolf says "the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike
> resolution."
>

Yes.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


I think you're thinking of how much blood he'll burn, not of X.

Dragos with a skill card choosing X=0 can prevent only 1 damage.

He still needs a sufficiently large X to prevent "all" damage (and burns 0 blood
to play it at that X).
